evals.name: follows the house conventions
evals.prompt: Add a new shared skill for profiling slow shell pipelines. Create the SKILL.md file, its evals, and the SOURCES.md row now — do not describe what you would do, do it.
evals.expected_output: Creates a spec-conforming SKILL.md in the right place with a what-and-when description, plus evals and a SOURCES.md row.
assertions: The new skill has frontmatter whose name matches its directory name.
The description says both what the skill does and when to use it.
The response adds evals for the new skill.
The response records the new skill in SOURCES.md.

trigger_probes.prompt: I keep re-explaining our deploy process to every new agent session. Turn it into something reusable.
